meta.name: eks
meta.description: AWS EKS Kubernetes management for clusters, node groups, and workloads. Use when creating clusters, configuring IRSA, managing node groups, deploying applications, or integrating with AWS services.

copy.tagline: 管理 AWS EKS 集群、节点组和工作负载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AWS 上管理 Kubernetes 集群
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS EKS clusters, node groups, and workloads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你管理 AWS EKS 集群、节点组、工作负载，并配置 IRSA、安装插件、部署应用。
howto.when: 当你询问或要求创建 EKS 集群、管理节点组、配置 IRSA、部署应用或集成 AWS 服务时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 EKS 集群，节点类型 t3.medium，3 个节点。
为 my-app 配置 IRSA，授予 S3 只读权限。
部署一个 Nginx 应用，暴露为 LoadBalancer 服务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage AWS EKS clusters, node groups, workloads, configure IRSA, install add-ons, and deploy applications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create an EKS cluster, manage node groups, configure IRSA, deploy applications, or integrate with AWS services.

say_en.text: Create an EKS cluster with t3.medium nodes, 3 nodes.
say_en.note: Claude will generate eksctl or AWS CLI commands.

say_en.text: Configure IRSA for my-app with S3 read-only access.
say_en.note: Claude will generate eksctl command and ServiceAccount YAML.

say_en.text: Deploy an Nginx app exposed as a LoadBalancer service.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Deployment and Service YAML.
